claims: Team USA defeated the Dominican Republic 2-1 on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Team USA advanced to the World Baseball Classic final.
Gunnar Henderson hit a solo home run in the 4th inning.
Roman Anthony hit a solo home run in the 4th inning.
Aaron Judge threw out Fernando Tatis Jr.
The game ended with a called third strike on a ball outside the zone against Dominican Republic's Geraldo Perdomo.
The final score was USA 2, Dominican Republic 1.
Team USA will play against Venezuela in the WBC championship on Tuesday.
